thread:
maya: Quick pitch  run a 6-week "latency sprint" with 6 design partners to validate SLOs + mitigations under real workloads. Focus: p99 and error-tail. Recruiting: production traffic, engineer contact, ok with short-term telemetry.

devin: Good. Propose two cohorts: spiky (burst rps) and steady. Different SLO config per cohort. Measurement: p99 over 1-min sliding windows, then report weekly 95th percentile of those minute values.

sam: Dashboard needs: prompt set, live p99 sparkline, recent incidents, and accept/priority actions. Minimal mock by Wed.

jen: Outreach plan  target customers who opened latency tickets in last 90d. Short invite DM + one-pager. Template ready.

ops-bot: capacity-check: reserved_slots=2 available, est_cost=$4k/slot/mo. Run `/reserve slots=1 tag=latency-sprint` to allocate.

paul: Legal: short DP addendum: telemetry opt-in, retention 30d, rollback right, partners can pause synthetic runs.

nina: CS success metrics: >=20% p99 improvement OR feature kept live for 8 weeks. Require 3 feedback sessions and >75% survey completion. SLA: 24h critical, 72h non-critical.

maya: Recruiting rubric idea: Commitment (0-3), Traffic fit (0-4), Security (0-3), Product signal (0-2). Accept if >=8. Prioritize regulated verticals but keep variety.

devin: Runbook tests: auto-fallback to model-compact, dynamic batch cap, KV prefill. Document quality delta for fallbacks.

maya: Timeline: Week0 onboard + baseline; W1-4 iterate; W5 stabilize; W6 wrap + playbook. Next steps: Jen send invites by Fri, ops run reserve by Mon, Sam deliver mock by Wed. Any blockers?

jen: I'll start outreach today.

sam: No blockers.
